name: Fixes
author: byo-pop
description: Mends bugs of the original BookWorm and leaves the game as it was: its rules, scores, sounds and pace. Each fix is a toggle; turn the whole mod off to play the original exactly as it was.

settings.label: The score glows as it rises
settings.help: The original has a glowing version of the score to show while points are added, but a rounding mistake keeps it invisible. With this on, it shows.
